_meta.name: DSS Ring Lock (steel, 73 cm, imperial bays)
_meta.family: Ringlock 0.73 m, imperial bays 5-10 ft (node 0.50 m)
_meta.note: US facade scaffold from the DSS (Blue Steel) System Scaffold Catalog 12/2025: 2'-4" (732 mm) ledgers as transoms, 5'/6'/7'/8'/10' bays, 2 x 12-1/2 in steel planks with hooks per bay, ledgers as guard rails, vertical diagonals for a 2 m lift. Values are catalog values; 'verified' = false until weighed/measured.
sources: 1067929480-BLUE-STEEL-DSS-03220-System-Scaffold-Catalog-12302025.pdf PDF p.25 (verticals), p.26 (ledgers), p.31 (starter collar), p.32 (vertical diagonals), p.41 (system jack), p.48 (adjustable toe board), p.49 (universal toe boards), p.58 (Twist Lock tube), p.60 (I-bolt clamps), p.87-88 (12-1/2 in steel planks), p.97 (hatch planks).
approvals: Ring Lock: Australia Registration, DITUC Certification (Chile), Bureau Veritas Certification (numbers not given)
changes: Initial draft from scratchpad/out/modular.json (DSS Ring Lock + DSS shared accessories), values re-checked on PDF p.31, 33, 41, 48, 49, 58, 60, 87, 88, 97.
The catalog's 'MM' column is in metres (0.01 m resolution); lengths taken from the ledger table in mm.

Bays = imperial series 5'/6'/7'/8'/10' (1524/1829/2130/2440/3051 mm), the US equivalents of 1.57-3.07: it is the only series with a diagonal, a plank, a universal toe board and a hatch for every length. The metric series (RLH52/69/86/101 = 1572/2072/2572/3070) has no 10'-1" diagonal and no toe boards for 2072/3070.
Extras 3' and 4' (914/1220). Transom = 2'-4" ledger RLH24 (732 mm), 2 x 12-1/2 in planks (2 x 318 = 636 mm).
Diagonal bay lengths printed 1.52/1.83/3.05 m matched to the 1524/1829/3051 mm ledgers; WBSWP100 (3051) and WBSWP7 (2130) are from the Canadian-sizes table p.88.
Hatch planks 28 in x 7' / 10' (effective 2.13 / 3.05 m) mapped to the 2130 / 3051 bays; their fit on a 2'-4" transom is not stated in the catalog.
Open end = 2 x RLH24 + adjustable toe board GRATB1 (24-38 in).
Base jack BPSJB: overall 0.54 m (22.22 in, titled '21 In'), max extension 0.38 m (15 in) from p.41 -> ext_max_mm 380.
Ties: tie tube = 4' Twist Lock tube TL4 (shortest tube in the catalog), coupler = right angle clamp CMPRA; eyebolt not in the catalog (0.2 kg estimated).
Brace l_mm = geometric axis length; the catalog gives bay x height only.
Load class and width class are not published: max_load_class 3 / 2.0 kN/m2 are defaults.

system.width_class: approx. W06 (EN 12811-1) from 2 x 318 mm planks; US catalog, no width class
system.load_note: Not published in the catalog (US catalog: OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart L, ANSI A10.8 referenced).
system.connection: Ring Lock rosettes at 500 mm (first 400 mm above the bottom); ledgers and diagonals with wedge heads; planks hook onto the ledger tube.

rules_verified.note: The catalog publishes no tie pattern, wall gap, bracing frequency, access spacing or free height: these are the ScaffVisor default values, not the manufacturer's. Jack travel: ext_max_mm from the catalog. DSS: swivel jacks must be anchored to hold 4 x the shear force; above 45 deg consult a Professional Engineer (p.41).
